direction: About 10 s. Medium still with a slow lateral move. The farmer cuts spelt with an iron sickle. Behind him his wife binds a sheaf with a twist of straw. Hands, straw and dust are lit by the sun. Over the brow of the hill, out of frame, a thin thread of chimney smoke rises from the stone house; the house itself is never shown. Ambience only. Placed after the first exchange so its PX-02 caption appears after 0:30.

Behind him a woman in her thirties with dark brown hair in a bun, strong cheekbones, grey-green eyes and a small mole on her left cheek, wearing a plain wool dress and shawl, binds a sheaf with straw.
